bio: I build the data and service layer that machine-learning systems run on top of.
Most of my work has been public-sector: a city-scale traffic platform, a national citizen-feedback system, and a crisis decision-support service.
I care most about the failure modes nobody sees — an import that exits zero while writing nothing, a tenant isolation rule that returns empty rows instead of raising.
I studied Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at Yarmouk University, finishing in 2025.
I am now in the 9xAI Program at HTU, working on government civic technology.

graduationProject.title: AgriBot AI
graduationProject.summary: A crop and fertiliser recommendation system running on a Raspberry Pi with live soil and weather sensor input. Gradient-boosted trees over engineered features, chosen because the board could hold and execute them: XGBoost at 99% and Random Forest at 94% on held-out agricultural and sensor data.
